.. _example_gallery:

NeuroAI-Toolkit Example Gallery
===============================

This gallery showcases various example usages of the `neusen_reveal` toolkit, demonstrating how to apply its modules for fMRI data cleaning, AI feature extraction, voxel-wise modeling, RSA, and more.

Each example provides a practical demonstration of the toolkit's capabilities, along with explanations of the code and expected outputs.
